info.name: Starfish Space Website Content API (WordPress REST v2) Users API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by user attribute.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to users with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: roles
params.description: Limit result set to users matching at least one specific role provided. Accepts csv list or single role.

params.name: capabilities
params.description: Limit result set to users matching at least one specific capability provided. Accepts csv list or single capability.

params.name: who
params.description: Limit result set to users who are considered authors.

params.name: has_published_posts
params.description: Limit result set to users who have published posts.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.
